title: The Widespread damage of the storm
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：widespread　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 widespread 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the ranger wrote of ① a widespread damage of the storm in the survey, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② so widespread that nobody in the valley would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the ranger, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the widespread ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the widespread damage of the storm that anybody there had ever seen, or so the survey for October 1950 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too widespread to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the villager who had come to help; the widespread ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a widespread belief in the village, and said that no villager in his right mind would call it ⑥ as widespread as the belief in the village they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was widespread or not, and he said so.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was ⑦ something widespread, and nothing besides. The villager from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite widespread; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the survey kept the names of the widespread ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966, in public, she wrote of another widespread damage of the storm in the same survey, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less widespread than anybody had expected. ⑩ The widespread belief in the village that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1968, was the one she could never quite name; the widespread ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 普遍（前置定语 a widespread damage of the storm：1956 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的那件普遍的广泛破坏）
B. adj. 普遍／广泛（两处加强说法：so widespread that … 与 no less widespread than …）
C. adj. 普遍／广泛（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 普遍（表语 too widespread to do：母亲觉得它太普遍，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 广泛（前置定语 a widespread belief in the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩广泛的观念）
F. adj. 广泛（同级比较 as widespread as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里普遍的观念相比）
G. adj. 广泛（后置定语 something widespread：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 广泛（受程度副词修饰 quite widespread：那位村民的评价）

items.q: a widespread damage of the storm
the widespread damage of the storm that
a widespread belief in the village
The widespread belief in the village that

answers.why: widespread 意为“普遍”，1956 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的是“一件普遍的广泛破坏”，此处作前置定语 a widespread damage of the storm。
widespread 意为“普遍”，此处用 so widespread that 结构，说它普遍到山谷里没人敢靠近。
widespread 意为“普遍”，踏勘记录上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的普遍风暴造成的广泛破坏，等于最高级的说法。
widespread 意为“普遍”，母亲认为这件东西“太普遍了，谁也用不上”，too widespread to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
widespread 意为“广泛”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩广泛的观念”，此处作前置定语 a widespread belief in the village。
widespread 意为“广泛”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里普遍的观念一样广泛”，同级比较用 as widespread as。
widespread 意为“广泛”，踏勘记录上那半行字要的是“广泛的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something widespread。
widespread 意为“广泛”，邻山谷来的那位村民认为这套计划“相当广泛”，quite 修饰原级 widespread。
widespread 意为“广泛”，no less widespread than 表示“其广泛不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之广泛不亚于任何人的预料。
widespread 意为“广泛”，母亲 1968 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的广泛观念”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，守林人在踏勘记录里记下了一件普遍的广泛破坏。（a widespread damage of the storm）
它普遍到山谷里没有一个人敢靠近。（so widespread that …）
母亲觉得它太普遍，谁也用不上。（too widespread to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩广泛的观念。（a widespread belief in the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里普遍的观念一样广泛。（as widespread as …）
到了 1963 年，踏勘记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件广泛的东西。（something widespread）
answers: In 1956 the ranger wrote of a widespread damage of the storm in the survey.
It was so widespread that nobody in the valley would go near it.
My mother thought it too widespread to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a widespread belief in the village.
He said nobody would call it as widespread as the belief in the village they had once had.
By 1963 the survey asked for nothing but something widespread.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 widespread 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the ranger wrote of a widespread damage of the storm in the survey, and nobody forgot it.
It was the widespread damage of the storm that anybody there had ever seen, or so the survey says.
My mother thought it too widespread to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a widespread belief in the village, and nobody argued with him.
The villager from the next valley called the plan quite widespread, and everybody laughed.
The widespread ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
